model.title: Pericles V exchange, assistance and training programme for the protection of the euro against counterfeiting 2028–2034

summary.text: The proposal aims to fund a programme that would provide training and support to law enforcement and other officials across participating countries to help them detect and prevent counterfeit euro banknotes and coins. It seeks to strengthen cooperation and share expertise on protecting the currency from counterfeiting threats.
